entities.summary: Vikram Misri is an Indian diplomat of the Indian Foreign Service, currently serving as the 35th Foreign Secretary of India since July 2024. Previously, he served as the Deputy National Security Advisor of India from January 2022 until July 2024, and as the ambassador of India to China from January 2019 to December 2021.
